title: Nonadjacent Maximum Sum
summary: Return the largest sum obtainable without choosing adjacent values.
statement: Return the largest sum obtainable without choosing adjacent values. Implement `nonadjacent_maximum_sum` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: Each position has take and skip states based on the prior position.
Update the best sum excluding or including the current value.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the nonadjacent_maximum_sum invariant is complete.
Editorial: Update the best sum excluding or including the current value. The intended bounds are O(n) time and O(1) space.
